utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. If you hear anything on the repair drive, let me know and I’ll keep my plans flexible.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Eli — I’m heading out now, and if I catch any news on the repair drive, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you need me to know about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Main thing: we’re just trying to get the repair drive moving, one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — what’s the next step I should help with?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm, this is the repair drive you mentioned, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s the one — I just want to make sure we’ve got the details sorted before anything gets dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so we’re still on for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to check what we still need. Want me to help sort things out?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please — could you check what tools and screws we still need? I’ll make a quick list of the supplies we’ve already got.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll go check the tools and screws we still need, and then I’ll report back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help—what exactly needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — sorry, I missed that. We need to figure out what items the repair drive is collecting and then sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — let’s confirm the accepted items first, then we can sort the donations by type.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late as usual, but I heard there’s a repair drive going on. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey, glad you’re here—just bring a couple tools if you’ve got them, and maybe some gloves.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got gloves and a basic tool kit—I’ll grab them and head over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and set them out by size? I’ve got the labels and a couple of bins ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools by size and set them out in the bins.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked any repair-drive locations yet, but I can help keep an eye out. If you hear one announced, tell me and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear one announced.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep watching for any announced repair-drive locations too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting started soon — I’m happy to pass along any details if you want them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, yes please — send me the details and I’ll spread the word around the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — it’s starting this Saturday morning at the community center, and they’re collecting tools, paint, and any small repair supplies. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going—do you need anything from me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for asking—I'm okay for now, but I may need a hand sorting donations later if that’s alright.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can help sort donations later. Just let me know when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking I’ll swing by the repair drive and see what they need. If you hear of anything specific, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m mostly hearing bits and pieces, so I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll check in at the repair drive and keep you posted if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and can send you the latest list of needed fixes. If you want, I can also line up the volunteers and timing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Please send me the latest list, and if you can, line up the volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send over the latest list and start lining up volunteers right away.
